attrs.author: Ricursive
attrs.summary: Ripple-65B Preview is an open-weight, 65B-parameter model from Ricursive for general-purpose, coding, and agentic workloads. It is a general-purpose variant of the proprietary model powering the Ricursive AI chip design platform, pretrained on 12 trillion tokens. Ricursive reports a score of 80.52 on TerminalBench 2.1. Context length: up to 1M tokens. Input: text. Output: text. License: Apache 2.0.
